evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('every … completes') enacts authority-ranking: a uniform requirement imposed on all new hires without negotiation.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page

observations.why: Reporting a supersession — one process replacing another — invokes authority-ranking as a governance act, but the relational signal is weak and propositional; flagged reported because the speaker is narrating a prior decision rather than performing the replacement here.
